upstream_findings.finding: A real CLI sender exists. Its actual learning handoff sends the existing sealed checkpoint bootstrap and same Root pidfd, not stage-owner or resident capabilities.
The original issuer has real policy-bound signing and durable sequence reservation. Existing permission is required; the audit neither declares the issuer absent nor exercises issuance.

Resident admission and readback have separate exact destination/operation-class bindings. Constructors require an existing SignedFinalUseGrant and already registered AuthorityLease; checkpoint handoff is not either.

The registration/recovery factory reopens original configured Root issuer/registry/directory. Agentd src has two fixture calls to register_host_resident_learning_v3, plus definition and two reexports; no production call. Extended exact symbol searches found none.
This child only verifies an already issued original intent at the original local fence. It never issues a grant or installs a lease.

PrecreatedProcessDriver transfers one already-held startup descriptor to the exact pinned child. Its Agentd caller is the finite native G2 path. All native_g2_entry Rust files in the complete Agentd src catalog contain no learning/resident token; UnixProcessDriver starts configured commands and does not build learning owners.

Current receive has checkpoint inputs only; require_root_learning_assembled must continue to refuse. Seven named assembly/enrollment entrypoints are single definitions with zero calls in all 926 Agentd Rust files and no symbol occurrence in the enumerated extended/config scope.
